channel.title: Jesus 4 Asia Now
channel.desc: We find out from the island chief what a difference our local teachers make in the entire community. Located in the Sulu Sea, the people have to eke out the living from fishing all night in the sea. They often take their children to help fish all night. If they don't catch anything, or if their fish don't sell in the morning, the family goes hungry. Our young teachers are bringing hope for not just a better life but for survival and the hope of eternal life in the hereafter.
